_doc: PIM4EntraPS workload template (engine/_shared/PIM-Conformance.ps1). A versioned set of PIM-group -> workload-role bindings. templateVersion + per-entry sinceVersion are a CHANGELOG label; rollout is by ring (tenantRing <= entryRing; 0 dev, 1 test, 2 broad). Only status:'approved' templates deploy. 'workload' = a connector id under workloads/connectors/. This sample models Defender XDR Unified RBAC: 3 roles at ring 2, a 4th piloting at ring 0.

versionHistory.summary: 3 built-in roles at ring 2 (broad; ring 0 in the pre-2.4.388 order)
